# Rasna Dental Care, Chittorgarh – Advanced Dental & TMJ Centre

> Dental clinic and TMJ centre at 4-A, Udaipur Rd, opp. Sabji Mandi Gate, Senthi, Bapu Nagar, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan 312001, India. Open all 7 days. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 96101 30090.

Doctors: Dr. Rasna Agrawal (B.D.S.), Dr. Pooja Jain (B.D.S., M.D.S. Oral Medicine & Radiology), Dr. Prakhar Agrawal (B.D.S., M.D.S. Oral Pathology), with associate dental surgeons.
Hours: Mon–Fri 10 AM–7:30 PM · Sat 10 AM–8 PM · Sun 10 AM–6 PM.
Appointments: call or WhatsApp +91 96101 30090, or use the request form on the home page. The clinic confirms every appointment by phone or WhatsApp.

## Treatments

- [TMJ & jaw pain](https://www.rasnadental.com/tmj-treatment-chittorgarh.html): Diagnosis and treatment for jaw (TMJ) pain, clicking and limited mouth opening: OPG X-ray, splints, TMJ appliances, medication and arthrocentesis.
- [Dental implants](https://www.rasnadental.com/dental-implants-chittorgarh.html): Dental implants at Rasna Dental Care, 4-A, Udaipur Rd, Senthi, Chittorgarh: single tooth, multiple teeth, full mouth implants, implant-supported dentures and bone grafting. Call or WhatsApp 96101 30090.
- [Root canal treatment](https://www.rasnadental.com/root-canal-treatment-chittorgarh.html): Root canal treatment (RCT) at Rasna Dental Care, 4-A, Udaipur Rd, Senthi, Chittorgarh. Single or multi-visit RCT with rotary instruments, followed by a cap. Call or WhatsApp 96101 30090.
- [Braces & aligners](https://www.rasnadental.com/braces-aligners-chittorgarh.html): Braces and clear aligners for children and adults at Rasna Dental Care, Senthi, Chittorgarh. Straighten crooked or gapped teeth and correct your bite. Call or WhatsApp 96101 30090.
- [Crowns & bridges](https://www.rasnadental.com/crowns-bridges-chittorgarh.html): Dental caps (crowns) and fixed bridges at Rasna Dental Care, Chittorgarh. Tooth-coloured ceramic and zirconia crowns to protect weak teeth and replace missing ones. Call or WhatsApp 96101 30090.
- [Check-ups & cleaning](https://www.rasnadental.com/dental-checkup-cleaning-chittorgarh.html): Dental check-ups, scaling and polishing, fluoride and sealants for children and adults at Rasna Dental Care, Senthi, Chittorgarh. Call or WhatsApp 96101 30090.
- [Cosmetic dentistry](https://www.rasnadental.com/cosmetic-dentistry-chittorgarh.html): Teeth whitening, veneers and smile design at Rasna Dental Care, Chittorgarh, for stained, chipped, gapped or uneven teeth. Call or WhatsApp 96101 30090.

## Articles

- [Does scaling weaken teeth? Three common myths about teeth cleaning](https://www.rasnadental.com/blog/scaling-myths-teeth-cleaning.html): Why teeth can feel different after cleaning, why gum problems come back, and why brushing matters even more in pregnancy.
- [Jaw clicking: when should you worry?](https://www.rasnadental.com/blog/jaw-clicking-when-to-worry.html): A click on its own is often harmless. When it needs a check-up, and what helps at home.
- [Root canal or extraction: how do we decide?](https://www.rasnadental.com/blog/root-canal-or-extraction.html): Why we try to save an infected tooth, and the cases where taking it out is the better choice.
- [दाँतों में ठंडा-गरम लगना: कारण और इलाज](https://www.rasnadental.com/blog/daant-mein-thanda-garam-lagna.html): ठंडा पानी या गरम चाय लगने पर झनझनाहट क्यों होती है, और कब डॉक्टर को दिखाना चाहिए।
